description: Returns every stage attempted for a run, ordered by pipeline order. A stage never attempted has no row at all, so 'not started' and 'started but pending' remain distinguishable -- this is what reporting.load_run_report uses to derive is_partial (ADR-016).
signature: def read_run_stages(conn: sqlite3.Connection, run_id: str) -> list[RunStage]
docstring:
Read every attempted stage's status for a run.

Args:
    conn: An open connection.
    run_id: The run to read stages for. Does not need to exist -- see edge cases.

Returns:
    A list of RunStage, ordered acquisition, enrichment, analysis regardless of insertion order. Stages never attempted are simply absent from the list.
postconditions: The returned list is ordered by pipeline stage order (acquisition, enrichment, analysis), never by insertion or attempt time
A run with all three stages succeeded returns exactly three RunStage entries, each status='succeeded'

edge_cases.input: run_id exists but no stage has ever been begun
run_id does not exist in runs at all
edge_cases.expected_behavior: empty list, not StorageError -- read_run_stages does not validate run existence, mirroring read_run_events' and read_enriched's own tolerant-read contracts; a caller wanting existence validation calls get_run separately

edge_cases.input: Only enrichment has ever been begun (acquisition row missing, e.g. from a hand-edited fixture)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: returns a single-element list containing only the enrichment row -- read_run_stages does not synthesize missing rows

unit_tests.name: test_all_three_stages_succeeded
unit_tests.description: A run with all three stages begun and finished 'succeeded' returns three RunStage rows in pipeline order.

unit_tests.name: test_no_stages_attempted_returns_empty
unit_tests.description: A freshly created run with no begin_run_stage calls yet returns an empty list.

unit_tests.name: test_unknown_run_id_returns_empty_not_error
unit_tests.description: A nonexistent run_id returns an empty list rather than raising.

unit_tests.name: test_ordering_independent_of_attempt_order
unit_tests.description: If analysis was begun before acquisition (e.g. a targeted stage re-run via PipelineConfig.start_stage), the returned order is still acquisition, enrichment, analysis.
unit_tests.expected: list ordered by pipeline stage, not by started_at
